Your request is an **Amber**‑level change – you’re adding a page that lets a single user (you) read all customer orders.  
We’ll build it with the safety habits built into Lovable + Supabase:

| Safety part | What we’ll do |
|-------------|---------------|
| **Login** | Use Supabase Auth (email magic link). Only your email gets “admin” role. |
| **Database rules** | Row‑level security (RLS) on the `orders` table: `<admin>` can read all rows; normal users can only read their own. |

| **Confirmation** | No delete/modify actions from the admin page – just read‑only. |
| **Per‑user lock‑in** | The admin page uses a custom claim in the JWT, so only you can reach it. |
